description: Polyperc 1 on channel 1 plays an eighth-note line for four bars at 90 BPM, MIDI 48, 55, 52, 55, 48, 55, 53 and 55 on the odd steps of every bar at velocity 70, short notes half a step long. In bars 1 and 2 nothing is locked. In bars 3 and 4 the Decay parameter is locked on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13 of each bar, so those four notes ring with a different decay from the notes between them while the notes themselves stay exactly the same. Listen for the plucks on the beat lengthening against the plain ones after them from bar 3, about 5.3 seconds in, and for the line sounding even again at the end of the cycle.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Parameter locks on and off
